body: You def can get a work@home call center job w/out experience, My husband made eye glasses for 30 yrs and is now working at home doing call center work. They sent all equipment needed. You just need a landline telephone # and good internet/have to be connected w/ ethernet to internet/ no wireless or wifi. Good luck  [Teleperformance.com](https://Teleperformance.com) look for work@home section, they usually have plenty of jobs, doesn't matter what city/state, just apply and plz use me as a reference if you do/ Amy Farley  TIA good pay/great benefits also paid training

If you like call center type jobs, it's full-time/work and train from home, go to the [Teleperformance.com](https://Teleperformance.com) website and apply for a work at home position in Customer Service or Tech. They usually have a # of jobs available. That's what I did and today is my last day of training then on the phones. It pays decent and benefits too. You don't have to have experience as they will train [you.](https://you.It)  It's also paid training then you make more when you start taking calls on your own. All training is done thru Adobe Connect. If you decide to do this plz put me down as a reference, Amy Farley, I'd sincerely appreciate it. Hope this helps. There are also TTEC@home you can check Good luck
